SCENE CONTEXT A single modern 4K Smart TV remote control prop, stripped down to a minimal button set, presented as a clean three-view product reference: front face, true side profile, and back shell. No hands, no environment, object only on a flat neutral medium-grey seamless background.
OBJECT Slim minimalist Smart TV remote, contemporary 2020s design language, matte-black soft-touch polymer body, rounded corners, thin tapered thickness. Reduced, primitive button layout — no streaming-app shortcut buttons (no Netflix, Prime Video, YouTube, Disney), no mic button, no back/home buttons.
Front face layout, top to bottom:
A single round power button at the very top-right.
Directly below the power area, a large "higgs 4K" wordmark in bright lime-chartreuse green, hex #D2F84E, prominently sized as the hero logo across the upper face.
Below the logo, a large central circular navigation ring with a glossy black round OK/select key in the middle and a thin chrome ring; four directional arrows (up, down, left, right) printed on the ring at top, bottom, left and right positions.
Below the ring, two simple control pairs side by side: a volume rocker on the left (a "+" key above a "−" key, small "VOL" label) and a channel rocker on the right (an up-chevron above a down-chevron, small "CH" label).
Clean, uncluttered, lots of empty matte-black space, premium minimalist aesthetic. Back shell: smooth tapered surface with a subtle recessed battery-compartment cover and a small "higgs 4K" logo in lime-chartreuse #D2F84E near the bottom.
LAYOUT Three identical remotes arranged left to right on the same horizontal baseline, evenly spaced, equal scale. Left = front view, face toward camera, fully readable. Center = strict side profile, edge-on in plane, showing thickness and slightly raised buttons in silhouette. Right = back view, rear shell toward camera. Object centered vertically, generous equal margins, no overlap, no cropping.
OPTICS 47° diagonal field of view, standard normal lens character, camera 3 to 4 meters back, zero distortion, straight rectilinear edges, natural proportions, deep depth of field so all three views stay razor-sharp front to back.
CAMERA Eye-level, locked static, dead-on orthographic framing for each view. No perspective tilt, no foreshortening.
LIGHTING Even soft studio softbox key from the front-upper, broad and shadowless, subtle gradient falloff on the grey background. Soft contact shadow directly beneath each remote to anchor it. No harsh reflections, no blown speculars, matte surfaces read as matte, the lime logo stays saturated and clean.
MATERIAL Soft-touch polymer absorbs light, rubber buttons show faint sheen, the lime-chartreuse "higgs 4K" logo reads as crisp colored print, chrome navigation ring shows a thin clean highlight. Pristine, dust-free, no fingerprints.
POSITIVE LOCKS Minimal primitive 4K Smart TV remote only — buttons limited to: power, central directional ring with OK and four arrows, volume rocker, channel rocker. No app shortcut buttons, no mic, no back/home keys. No hands, no props, no text overlays except the "higgs 4K" logo and the small VOL/CH labels and arrow glyphs. The "higgs 4K" logo color stays exactly lime-chartreuse hex #D2F84E on both front and back. Background stays flat neutral medium grey. All three views share identical body, color, scale, and lighting. Logo spelling stays exactly "higgs 4K".
